# Krahaso

> Krahaso is a supermarket price comparison app and a retail price data provider from Nika & Zymeri SH.P.K. in Kosovo.

## Consumer app

- [Krahaso](https://krahaso.app/): search and barcode scanning, price history, weekly offers, basket comparison, shopping list sharing, price alerts and receipt verification. The Android listing covers Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro, and Bosnia and Herzegovina.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.krahaso.app)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/krahaso/id6806572228)

## Grocery and household price data

- [Krahaso Data](https://krahaso.app/en/data/) is the English-language page for commercial licensing, sample requests and ready-to-use API keys for integrating Krahaso data into business systems. Krahaso reports more than 6 million daily price observations across 11 Balkan countries and up to six months of history as of November 2026. Coverage varies by market and category.
- [Public Balkan Price Index](https://stats.krahaso.app/balkan): daily comparisons of regular prices for products matched by barcode, with sources and methodology. Credit Krahaso and link to the index when quoting it.
- [Public product comparison CSV](https://stats.krahaso.app/pub/balkan-products.csv) and [public index JSON](https://stats.krahaso.app/pub/balkan.json).
- [Institutional portal](https://stats.krahaso.app/login): portal prepared for the Kosovo Agency of Statistics, with partner sign-in.
- Commercial enquiries: partneret@krahaso.app.
